jamie: Mornin' all — quick async standup. Merged kernel microbatch fairness patch last night (PR #3321). Observed +2ms p50 on 128-token runs but p95 unchanged. Rolling canary to 10% :eyes:

nina: nice, which canary pool?

jamie: canary on dedicated-pool-3 (eu-west). Also toggled kv-prefetch heuristic to aggressive for 2h to see warmup. Keeping old kernel as fallback.

mike: noted. I'll watch canary traces. saw a couple of tiny OOMs in canary logs around 02:12 UTC — attaching snippet. :thinking:

mike: ```log
2026-03-16T02:12:08Z kernel:OOM: slot 42 evict failed
model=redwood/tiny-qa seq=512
```

priya: I can reproduce locally with synthetic repro. Might be a race in slot reclamation when prefetch is on.

lucas: is the eviction metric spike correlated with microburst traffic? I saw a small spike at 02:11.

jamie: yeah microburst. Plan: rollback heuristic to conservative if OOMs >3 in 30m. Otherwise continue canary and collect perf profiles.

nina: perf numbers? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

jamie: quick numbers (baseline vs canary):
- baseline p50: 12.1ms, p95: 48ms
- canary p50: 14.3ms, p95: 49ms
throughput unaffected. KV hitrate improved ~4% after prefetch.

priya: can you post the perf bench command?

jamie: ```bash
./bench/run_microbench --model tiny-qa --seq 128 --concurrency 16 --duration 60
```

mike: bumped PR review for #3322 (kv warmup tuning). @priya can you take a look? small change. :thumbsup:

priya: on it, ping if you want pairing.

lucas: quick FYI — I'll be offline from 18:00 PT for infra maintenance. If anything spikes, ping @mike or @jamie.

ops-bot: Rolling canary started: kernel-mb-fairness v2 -> 10% on dedicated-pool-3. ID=canary-20260316-1102

jamie: thanks. blockers: need priya to confirm if eviction race is reproducible with new timing patch. Otherwise nothing blocking.

priya: reproducing now, will post results in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
